name: model-router
description: Routes each turn and subagent to a cheaper model when the task is simple, never above the model you picked

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: auto: route main-loop turns and subagents; subagents: route subagents only (keeps the main loop's prompt cache intact); off: do nothing

lightModel.title: Model for light tasks
lightModel.description: Lookups, explanations, renames, formatting, small edits

standardModel.title: Model for standard tasks
standardModel.description: Routine implementation, bug fixes, tests. Heavy tasks always keep the session's own model

routedAgents.title: Subagent types to route
routedAgents.description: Comma-separated agent types whose model the router may choose when the caller named none

useClassifier.title: Ask a small model when the keyword rules are unsure
useClassifier.description: Costs one small-model call per ambiguous prompt

escalateAfterSteps.title: Escalate after this many model requests in one turn
escalateAfterSteps.description: A routed turn that keeps going is probably harder than it looked: from this step on it moves up one tier
